text:
anya: Putting together follow-ups from the recent kv-cache OOM postmortem. Focus: reproducibility, tenant guardrails, GC tuning, and alerting. Thread to collect owners and short ETAs.
matt: thanks. I can own the repro harness and run nightly captures on staging.
lin: I'll take GC/slab experiments on canary. plan to test frag_threshold bump + aggressive compact window.
gabe: ops will add tenant soft limit rule and the residency-delta alert. also can run synthetic eviction job.
ops-bot: note: synthetic eviction job template exists: infra/jobs/kv_synthetic_eviction.yaml (cron 02:30 UTC)
anya: repro checklist (matt): enable alloc-sampler, do 6h peak run with client qps ramp to 20k, and collect kv-snapshot every 30m. upload to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/pm-2380012345/
matt: command I used locally:
```bash
export TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtraces
./kv_harness --pool=staging --clients=120 --skew=0.85 --duration=21600 --alloc-sample=2% --out=$TRACE_DIR/trace-$(date +%s).tgz
```
lin: tuning plan (canary):
- A: frag_threshold: 0.35 -> 0.48 (48h)
- B: compact-window: 60s -> 30s for heavy shards (72h)
- C: enable eager-evict for segments > 96MB on canary (72h)
Rollback if p99 read latency > 1.8x or OOM.
gabe: ops tasks:
- add alert: residency-delta > 18% sustained for 10m -> page oncall
- add tenant-soft-multiplier: for tenants >95th percentile, cap effective residency to 0.9x for 48h guardrail
- schedule synthetic eviction cron and add runbook link
anya: can we make the tenant soft-multiplier opt-out per-tenant for enterprise ones? some customers expect steady capacity.
gabe: yes, we'll allow exceptions and document in the rollout RFC. default rule applies to all non-exempt tenants.
ops-bot: ticket created: OPS-5123 residency-delta alert (assignee: gabe)
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: slab-config patch -> pool-canary-1 -> ETA 2026-04-01T04:00:00Z
matt: I'll push the harness changes and a short gist with repro steps tonight.
lin: I'll prepare the canary config diff and unit test the compact logic.
anya: ownership summary (confirm):
- repro harness & traces: matt (ETA 1d)
- upload & trace pointer in postmortem: matt (ETA 1d)
- slab GC experiments: lin (canary start 2026-04-01)
- tenant guardrail + alerting: gabe/ops (ETA 2026-04-01 12:00 UTC)
- retro writeup with metrics and links: anya (ETA 2026-04-04)
gabe: confirmed for ops tasks. will attach runbook and ticket links here when done.
matt: note: repro appears tied to key-hotness >0.8 and sustained growth-rate >12% over 5m. adding that to the alert proposition.
lin: caution: eager-evict increases eviction churn; we'll add dashboard panels for residency, eviction-rate, and p99 read latency.
anya: we will reconvene in 48h with metrics snapshots. if anyone sees an OOM during canary, ping #eng-oncall and escalate. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
